audit.why: Level chart already has Janna favored all 7 rows and content win[] agrees (all "Janna") — this is a disengage-support matchup where Janna's kit denies Leona's engage at every stage, which matches Riot's kit text (Zephyr slow, Howling Gale knockup, Monsoon).
Spikes already correctly identify level 2 E-Q all-in, level 6 Monsoon countering Solar Flare, first item, and late peel war — all grounded in real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Leona's own W (Eclipse) and a generic R line but contains no digit anywhere, failing the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT lint. It should state Janna's Howling Gale (14s cd) and Leona's own Eclipse (14/13/12/11/10) and Solar Flare (90/75/60) cooldowns.
audit.why: Howling Gale is Janna's 14s-cooldown zone/knockup that breaks Leona's engage; Leona's Eclipse shield is 14/13/12/11/10s and her R is 90/75/60s. Real numbers let the reader time the trade instead of reading vague filler.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions data flags that Janna sustains through chip damage via Monsoon's heal and Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades, but report[8] (Itemization) only says "anti-heal early" with no timing guidance, and it misgenders Janna as "his".
audit.why: Monsoon's heal ticks continuously while active, so Grievous Wounds applied before the heal starts (not after Janna has already topped her carry) is what actually blunts it.
